title: Account Executive, Enterprise
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

不確実さを力に変えられる人 ：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

Enterprises do not buy AI infrastructure one product at a time. They buy it from the reseller who already holds the paper, the services capacity, and the trust. • Recruitment and activation: You will recruit against a filter, not for coverage. A short list of VARs who can actually source AI infrastructure and platform engineering deals beats a long list who cannot. You will own the path from first conversation to first transaction (agreement, track admission, enablement, first registered deal, first close) and retire non-performing partners without drama. Time from signature to first dollar is your headline metric.

• Transaction mechanics: You will own the reseller commercial model: tier discounts, deal-registration uplift, renewal margin, volume incentives, and named-account bonuses. • Field alignment: You will make co-sell comp-neutral so our sellers get full quota credit and never fight the channel. You will build named-account maps between vCluster sellers and partner sellers with deal registration the field trusts, and give partner sellers a reason to lead with vCluster: margin they can count on, services attach they can sell, and a technical story their SEs can carry.

• Multi-party plays with the ecosystem: You will connect reseller opportunities to the NVIDIA alliance and the OEM and ISV design wins your peers land, so a WWT or Computacenter seller can quote a validated stack with vCluster already inside it. Where a GSI, ISV, or distributor accelerates a reseller deal, you bring them in.

You will run joint marketing with pipeline objectives attached (field events, webinars, named-account campaigns, customer stories) and approve MDF against pipeline outcomes with proof of performance enforced. Discretionary spend earns its return or it stops.

• Owning the channel number: MEDDPICC on every partner-attached opportunity. Weekly pipeline inspection. Partner attribution queryable from day one; pipeline we cannot query is pipeline we do not have. QBRs on a fixed cadence with a fixed agenda: bookings against plan, named-account inspection, certification status, marketing execution, renewal health, forward-quarter plan. This is a first-year partner program with team MBOs and OKRs; you report your KPIs without being asked: transacting partners, sourced and attached pipeline and bookings, registration volume and win rate, certified resources, MDF return.

description:
About the role
We are building AI systems that generate production-quality motion from natural language. The system combines frontier language models, an AI generation harness, and a text-native Motion DSL designed for structured, editable animation.
This role spans two connected areas: improving the production generation system used today, and developing specialized models that can generate the Motion DSL directly with higher quality, lower latency, and better cost efficiency.
You will work at the intersection of LLM systems, post-training, code generation, compilers, evaluation, data engineering, and motion design. This is a hands-on engineering role with end-to-end ownership and measurable product impact.
Key Responsibilities
Build and improve production generative systems

• Design and ship improvements across prompt interpretation, model orchestration, routing, retrieval, tool use, structured generation, validation, repair, and visual verification.

• Diagnose recurring failure modes and turn them into durable improvements in prompts, data, system logic, constraints, or evaluation.

• Build compiler-backed feedback loops and deterministic quality gates that prevent invalid or low-quality outputs from reaching users.

• Develop experiments and fixed evaluation batteries that show whether a change genuinely improves output quality.

Train specialized generative models

• Design supervised fine-tuning datasets, training recipes, and post-training experiments for direct Motion DSL generation.

• Explore distillation, preference optimization, synthetic-data generation, reinforcement-learning approaches, and constrained generation where they are the right tools.

• Select checkpoints using robust evaluations across correctness, visual quality, reliability, latency, and cost - not training loss alone.

• Determine whether a model failure is best addressed through data, training, inference, evaluation, or the underlying language/runtime.

Build the data and evaluation foundation

• Turn production generations into high-quality training and evaluation datasets using filtering, provenance, versioning, deduplication, and contamination controls.

• Design train, validation, and evaluation splits that minimize leakage and preserve meaningful generalization tests.

• Create failure taxonomies, hard negatives, regression suites, and representative prompt batteries.

• Combine deterministic checks, model-based judges, render evidence, and human review into a reliable evaluation system.

What we're looking for

• Strong ML and software engineering
You have built and operated production AI or machine-learning systems, not only prototypes. You are comfortable moving across model behavior, data pipelines, APIs, infrastructure, evaluation, and product code.

• Hands-on LLM training experience
You have practical experience with supervised fine-tuning and modern post-training workflows. You understand how dataset construction affects model behavior and can explain how you prevent leakage, contamination, and misleading evaluation results.

• Strong evaluation instincts
You know that generative systems improve only when they can be measured. You can design experiments, regression suites, automated graders, and evaluation datasets that distinguish real gains from noise.

• Experience with structured or code generation
Experience with code-generation models, DSLs, grammars, parsers, compilers, structured outputs, constrained decoding, or program synthesis is especially relevant. The generated output is executable structured code, so syntactic and semantic correctness both matter.

• Production engineering judgment
You treat observability, reliability, latency, inference cost, caching, failure recovery, and maintainability as part of the ML system itself.

• Product and visual judgment
You can distinguish technically valid output from work that feels polished. Experience with animation, motion design, graphics, creative tooling, or multimodal system

title: GTM Engineer

Levanta is the creator affiliate platform built for modern e-commerce. We connect brands, creators, publishers, and marketplaces through a single platform for creator discovery, activation, partnership management, payments, and cross-channel performance measurement. Through our Creator Marketplace and AI-powered Social Discovery, brands can access more than 90,000 vetted creators and millions more across TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook, building measurable creator partnerships across Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, and other retail channels.

Following our recent $22 million Series B, which brought our total funding to more than $43 million, we are investing further in our technology, our team, and our expansion across the retail ecosystem. We are building the infrastructure for Creator Commerce Media and creating more opportunities for brands to grow, creators to earn, and marketplaces to generate measurable demand.

We're hiring a GTM Engineer to own the systems that power how we find, engage, and convert customers. This role sits within the Revenue org, operating across Sales, Marketing, and RevOps - built for someone who thinks in pipelines, builds in Clay, and measures success in meetings booked and revenue influenced.
What You'll Do:
Outbound Infrastructure

• Build and maintain automated lead generation systems: enrichment pipelines, ICP scoring models, and sequencing logic

• Own email deliverability infrastructure: domain setup, warm-up, authentication, inbox rotation, and ongoing monitoring

• Design personalization and dynamic copy logic that drives reply rates, not just sends

Revenue Automation

• Build automated workflows connecting our GTM stack (CRM, sequencers, data sources, and enrichment tools) via APIs, webhooks, and automation platforms

• Identify and operationalize buying signals to trigger outbound at the right moment for the right contact

• Maintain HubSpot as the source of truth: clean data, meaningful properties, functional workflows

Tooling & Operations

• Evaluate and pilot new AI and GTM tools, integrating what works into the core stack

• Own reporting on pipeline influenced by automated systems - meetings booked, sequences launched, lead-to-opportunity conversion

• Partner with AEs and SDRs to identify workflow gaps, broken handoffs, and opportunities to automate manual work

What We're Looking For:
**This role weighs demonstrated skills over resume credentials. We'll ask for a portfolio and evaluate hands-on ability during the interview process.**

• Proven experience in GTM engineering, RevOps, growth engineering, or a technical demand gen role, or a sales background where you've built your own systems

• Hands-on experience building data enrichment workflows and multi-step automation in production

• Proficiency with CRM platforms (we use HubSpot) and email automation tooling

• Comfortable making API calls, working with webhooks, and connecting tools via no-code/low-code automation platforms

• Commercial instinct. You think in pipeline generated and demos booked, not automations shipped

• Able to move fast, work autonomously, and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders

Nice to have:

• Experience with affiliate or partner marketing platforms; familiarity with the Ecommerce seller ecosystem; SQL or basic Python

What Levanta Offers:

• A dynamic and supportive work environment where innovation and creativity are encouraged.

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Open vacation and sick policy, take the time you need.

• Opportunity for professional growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding startup.

• A culture that values diversity, inclusion, and the impact of every team member on our success.

• Must have a permanent address in one of our hub states: California, Florida, New York, Ohio, Utah, Texas, Michigan, Washington, Colorado, Massachusetts, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, or DC.

Anduril's Air Dominance & Strike (AD&S) division delivers platforms, systems, and integrated effects across autonomous air vehicles and advanced munitions. This role is based in our Costa Mesa, CA. We are in office 5 days per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

• Identify areas of opportunity across our P&L, cash flow, and balance sheet.

• Stay current on market trends and best-in-class financial performance benchmarks.

• Partner cross-functionally with Program Engineering, Supply Chain, Accounting, and Finance teams to build fidelity into our financial models.

• 7+ years of experience in strategic finance, corporate finance, investment banking, private equity, consulting, or another highly analytical role.

• Expert modeling and analytical skills.

• An exemplary ability to distill complex financial information into actionable insights.

• Excellent communication skills and “story telling” ability when presenting data insights.

• An understanding of business models and metrics that are relevant to Anduril (i.e. software, manufacturing, and government contract structures).

• Strong enthusiasm about technology, production, and artificial intelligence.

• Best-in-class attention to detail and unwavering commitment to accuracy.

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities
